d: Bihar MLC Election Result: bihar ki rajniti men ek aisi tasvir samne aaee hai... jisne aarjedi aur tejasvi yadav ki chinta barha di hai.... jis brahman samaj ko kabhi aarjedi ka paranpragat virodhi mana jata tha, usi samaj ke voton ne darbhanga snatak sit par lalu yadav ki parti ko jit dilane men aham bhumika nibhaee.... bijepi apne hi garh men charon khane chit ho gaee aur aarjedi ne ek bara ulatpher kar diya.... lekin kahani men tvist yahin khatm nahin hota.... kyonki jis jit ka jashn aarjedi ko manana chahie tha, usi jit ke pichhe ek aisa siyasi sanket chhipa hai, jo aane vale dinon men…
